objective: Create one coherent embedded software architecture specification from several overlapping technical notes. Resolve duplicated explanations, identify contradictions, and clearly flag undecided design choices.
scope: Boot sequence, drivers, middleware and application modules.
Preserve unresolved interface questions and alternatives.
quality_criteria: Flag uncertain design choices rather than inventing decisions.
constraints: Do not overwrite the source notes.
